note_en: The pattern 一…就… links two actions: "as soon as…, then…" 新歌一上线，大家就要反复播放 "as soon as a new song comes out, everyone has to play it over and over"; 他一开口，小雨就忘了榜单 "the moment he started singing, Xiaoyu forgot the charts." The first part is the trigger, the second the instant response. Note also 得 in 排得满满的: it introduces the degree of the result after the verb — "booked solid."
